method.cost: One learned scale per channel per block in the candidate, versus one learned scalar per block in the control; negligible arithmetic relative to the existing convolutions. Training cost is unmeasured.
method.mechanism: Agent hypothesis: initialize each candidate residual-branch channel scale to 1 and return residual + scale * branch_output. The generated control initializes one learned scalar per block to 1 and applies it uniformly to every channel. Their comparison tests channel-specific scaling against generic learned residual scaling.
